name: Levocetirizine

fda.text: Do not use if you have kidney disease if you have ever had an allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients or to an antihistamine containing cetirizine Ask a doctor before use if you have ever had trouble urinating or emptying your bladder When using this product drowsiness may occur avoid alcoholic…

examples.title: Prevention of Asthma With Levocetirizine (36 Month Treatment) in Young Children Suffering From Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) and Sensitized to…
examples.why: The predecessor study A00309 (NCT00152464) did not show statistical significance in time to onset of asthma between the levocetirizine and placebo groups.

examples.title: The Effect of Levocetirizine on Inflammatory Mediators in Dermatographism
examples.why: Mediators of interest were not consistently detectable with the analytical methods employed.

summary: Warnings for levocetirizine state that you should not take it if you have kidney disease, or if you have had an allergic reaction to this medicine, its ingredients, or allergy medicines with cetirizine [3]. The label also advises talking to a doctor before use if you have had difficulty urinating or emptying your bladder, and notes that sleepiness can happen and alcohol should be avoided [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model rather than human testing gave the drug a low liver risk score and a high heart risk score [M].
